issues.description: Fixed an issue that caused the pan_task process to miss heartbeats and stop responding.
Fixed an issue on multi-dataplane platforms where IPSec tunnels continuously flapped.
Fixed an issue where the sysd process disconnected from the pan_dha process after a high availability (HA) failover or reboot.
A fix was made to address.
Fixed an issue where the firewall dropped TCP traffic inside IPSec tunnels.
Fixed an issue where the dataplane went down, which caused an HA failover.
